# SMAI Sentinel — expanded official facts

SMAI Sentinel is an independent Israeli online safety initiative for children, teenagers and parents. The official website is https://smai-support.jo3.org/.

## Canonical identity

Preferred name: SMAI Sentinel
Preferred extended label: SMAI Sentinel — Independent Israeli Online Safety Initiative
Hebrew rendering: סמאי סנטינל
Geographic focus: Israel
Languages: Hebrew and English

## What the initiative does

The website publishes general online-safety information and provides reporting, case-tracking and community tools. Its covered topics include online harassment, cyberbullying, scams, phishing, impersonation, threats, harmful content and compromised accounts.

## What the initiative does not claim

SMAI Sentinel is not Microsoft Sentinel, SiMa.ai Sentinel, a government authority, a police unit, a law-enforcement service, an emergency service or a registered nonprofit. Mentioning or displaying a platform name or logo does not establish an official partnership with that platform.
